questions.stem: 對於那些一味追求流行的人來說，手機和衣服往往還能用就被丟掉了。
questions.answer: For those who blindly pursue trends, mobile phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
accepted_answers: For those people who always chase the latest fashions, phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
For people who blindly follow fashion trends, mobile phones and clothes often get thrown away while they are still usable.

patterns: 對於…的人而言（For those (people) who …）
被動語態（被丟掉、還能被使用）

questions.stem: 他們生活在一個廣告無所不在的社會，因此無論擁有多少，總覺得還不夠。
questions.answer: They live in a society where advertisements are all around, so no matter how much they possess, they never feel they have enough.
accepted_answers: They live in a society where advertising is everywhere, so no matter how much they own, they always feel it is not enough.
They live in a society in which ads can be seen everywhere, so no matter how much they have, it never seems enough.

patterns: 讓步：無論…（no matter how much）
關係副詞 where（廣告無所不在的社會＝a society where …）

1.explanation_zh: 「對於那些…的人來說」用 For those who＋V …；those 可以單獨當「那些人」，也可以當限定詞修飾 people，寫成 For those people who … 一樣正確。「流行」在這裡是名詞「潮流」，寫 trends／fashion。手機和衣服是「被丟掉」的，用被動 are thrown away；「還能用」也要用被動 can still be used（或 still work），用 even though 連接表讓步。
evidence: 對於那些一味追求流行的人來說
1.strategy_zh: 句首 For those who … 交代對象，主要子句以「手機和衣服」為主詞寫成被動，最後用 even though 補上「還能用」。
hints: 切成四段：對於那些一味追求流行的人來說／手機和衣服／還能用／就被丟掉了
標的詞彙：pursue（追求）、trend（流行）、phone（手機）、use（使用）、throw away（丟掉）
句型框架：For those (people) who + V …, S + be + often + p.p. + even though …

2.explanation_zh: 「廣告無所不在的社會」的修飾語是完整子句（廣告無所不在），缺的是「在那裡」，用關係副詞 where（＝in which）：a society where advertisements are all around。「無論擁有多少」用 no matter how much＋S＋V，指總量用 much。「總覺得還不夠」補上主詞：they never feel they have enough。
2.strategy_zh: 主幹 They live in a society，後面接 where 子句；再用 so 接結果，結果句前面放 no matter how much 的讓步子句。
hints: 切成四段：廣告無所不在／的社會／無論擁有多少／總覺得還不夠
標的詞彙：society（社會）、advertisement（廣告）、possess（擁有）、feel（覺得）、enough（足夠的）
句型框架：S + live in a society where + S + V, so no matter how much + S + V, S + V …

references: For those who blindly pursue trends, mobile phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
For those people who always chase the latest fashions, phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
For people who blindly follow fashion trends, mobile phones and clothes often get thrown away while they are still usable.

traps.literal_error: For those who blindly pursue popular,
traps.explanation_zh: 「追求流行」的「流行」是名詞「潮流」，英文用 trends／fashion；popular 是形容詞，不能當 pursue 的受詞。

traps.literal_error: mobile phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still use
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「還能用」沒有說出「誰用」；照字面寫 they can still use，they 指手機和衣服，就變成手機自己在使用東西，要改成被動 can still be used。

bonus.explanation_zh: 改用 Those who … 當主詞的主動句，加上 tend to（往往）與 perfectly usable（完全堪用），語意更清楚。

1.restructuring_zh: 「手機和衣服往往還能用就被丟掉了」中文先說「還能用」再說「被丟掉」，英文主要子句放前面 are often thrown away，再用 even though they can still be used 補充讓步。

traps.explanation_zh: 「無所不在」是四字成語，英文說 are all around／are everywhere 即可；逐字翻成 exist in everywhere 會多出介系詞。

traps.literal_error: so no matter how much they possess, always feel not enough
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「總覺得還不夠」省略了主詞「他們」；英文主要子句要補主詞 they，feel 後面也要接完整的子句 it is not enough／they have enough。

bonus.text: Surrounded by advertisements, they never feel they have enough, however much they own.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用過去分詞構句 Surrounded by advertisements 交代背景，讓步改用 however much they own 放句尾，句構更緊湊。

2.restructuring_zh: 「廣告無所不在的社會」是有主詞、動詞的子句修飾名詞，英文改成放在名詞後面的關係副詞子句 a society where advertisements are all around；「總覺得還不夠」省略主詞，英文要補上 they。

1.translation: For those who blindly follow trends, cell phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
1.explanation_zh: 「那些一味追求流行的人」用 those who blindly follow trends；中文主詞是物品，所以用被動 are often thrown away；「還能用就被丟掉」的「就」表示讓步，用 even though they can still be used。英文更自然的寫法其實是主動句 People who blindly follow trends often throw away ...，所以信心給 medium。

2.translation: They live in a society where advertisements are everywhere, so no matter how much they own, they always feel it is not enough.
2.explanation_zh: 「一個廣告無所不在的社會」用關係副詞 where 修飾 society；「因此」用 so 連接；「無論擁有多少」用 no matter how much they own；「總覺得還不夠」譯 they always feel it is not enough（也可寫 they never feel they have enough）。

issues_zh: 主動改寫 People who blindly follow trends often throw away phones and clothes even though they can still be used 比「For those who …, … are often thrown away」更自然（加分寫法也是主動句），但第 1 部分只收 For those/people who 開頭，第 4 部分還把 often throw away 列為常見錯誤，這種正確的主動句最多只拿 2 分。建議第 1 部分補 Those/People who blindly follow trends，第 4 部分補主動的 often throw away，常見錯誤改成被動句漏 be 動詞的情形（phones and clothes often throw away）。

problems: 第 1 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：主動改寫 People who blindly follow trends often throw away phones and clothes even though they can still be used 比「For those

1.translation: For those who blindly follow trends, phones and clothes are often thrown away while they are still usable.
1.explanation_zh: 「對於那些……的人來說」用 For those who ...；「一味追求流行」用 blindly follow trends；「還能用就被丟掉」用被動語態加 while they are still usable（也可用 even though they still work）。

2.translation: They live in a society where advertisements are everywhere, so no matter how much they own, they always feel that it is not enough.
2.explanation_zh: 「廣告無所不在的社會」用關係副詞 where 引導子句；「因此」用 so 連接兩個分句；「無論擁有多少」用 no matter how much；「總覺得還不夠」可寫成 feel that it is never enough，這裡用 always ... not enough。
